cutoff.rule: R6/R12/R17/RB13: a results row is eligible for a fixture starting on date S iff completion_upper_bound <= S - lag (inclusive), publication_upper_bound_utc <= issue time, receipt time <= issue time, and overlap_unresolved is false. Serve state and rankings are as-of the last block or list whose declared bound is <= S - lag. A results-only update never advances serve or ranking freshness.
